## Certificate of Recognition to MGIT by Global Education and Careers Forum

News Date : 28 Jan 2023News ReportThe Global Education and Careers Forum (GECF) organized Global Education and Admissions Fair today , 28/01/2023, at Sultan-Ul-Uloom Society, Road No. 3 Banjara hills, Hyderabad for the benefit of Engineering undergraduates of Telangana who wish to pursue higher education overseas.The G-Cell of MGIT is affiliated to the GECF and extends all the services and benefits of the GECF to its student community for free.In the picture is seen Prof. K.Sudhakar Reddy, Vice.Principal, MGIT receiving the ‘Certificate of Recognition’ in the event from Sri Navin Mittal, I.A.S. Commissioner, Higher Education, Technical Education and Intermediate Education of Telangana and also the Chairperson of the GECF .
